mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_account ( bank_user_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_name, account_holder_name, balance, status, creation_request_id, creation_request_hash ) VALUES ( #{bankUserId}, #{bankCode}, #{bankName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountName}, #{accountHolderName}, #{balance}, #{status}, #{creationRequestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creationRequestHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.sql: creation_request_id, creation_request_hash, account_id, bank_user_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_name, account_holder_name, balance, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id, a.bank_user_id, a.bank_code, a.bank_name, a.account_number, a.account_name, a.account_holder_name, a.balance, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM bank_account a JOIN bank_user i ON a.bank_user_id = i.bank_user_id WHERE i.user_key_hash = #{userKey} ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
